alsoSignOut: Also sign out of this profile
backupOrder: Config is copied out, projects/ and file-history/ are archived and verified, and only then is anything edited or deleted. Signing out comes last.
claudeRunning: {count, plural, one {Claude Code is running (# process).} other {Claude Code is running (# processes).}} Quit it first: cleaning a session's transcript while it is open can fail.
cleanDetail: This removes {what} after backing up to {folder}. Deleted files can only come back from the backup.
cleanupDaysNote: How many days Claude Code keeps transcripts before it deletes them itself.
commandLineNote: Installs ccgj and ccguanjia in {dir}: ccgj list, ccgj run <profile>, ccgj use <profile>.
copyServersNote: Adds only the servers this profile doesn't have, in mcpServers of its .claude.json. The rest of the file stays as it is.
created: Created. Run {command} in a new terminal to sign in.
csAlwaysThinkingNote: Start each session with extended thinking on.
csAutoCompactNote: Compact the conversation when the context is nearly full.
csBacksUp: The file is backed up before it is written.
csBackupsNote: Each save backs the file up first, into {path}.
csChanged: settings.json changed since it was read, perhaps from Claude Code. Reload it, or overwrite it with your changes.
csChanges: {count, plural, =0 {No changes} one {# change} other {# changes}}
csCopyNote: The keys chosen take {name}'s values here, and those {name} lacks are removed. Review them before saving.
csDefaultModeNote: The permission mode sessions start in.
csDetachNote: Makes this profile's settings.json a copy of its own, so that its changes are its alone.
csDetached: settings.json is now this profile's own
csDisableHooksNote: Claude Code runs none of the hooks below, nor the status line.
csEffortNote: How hard the model thinks, where it supports it.
csEnvNote: Variables Claude Code sets in each session. Values of names with KEY, TOKEN, SECRET or PASSWORD are hidden.
csFixFirst: Fix these in the JSON before saving.
csHooksNote: Change hooks and the status line in the JSON.
csKeysDiffer: {count, plural, =0 {alike} one {# key differs} other {# keys differ}}
csModelNote: An alias such as opus or sonnet, or a model's full name. Empty leaves it to Claude Code.
csNoFile: There is no settings.json yet. Saving makes one.
csRevert: Put back {key} as the file has it
csSharedWith: This file is shared with {names}: a change here changes them too.
csUnsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
csValidJSON: Valid JSON, and every key it knows has its type.
daysAgo: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
defaultForShellsNote: With the shell file, a new shell sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR to this profile, so plain claude uses it.
dropDeadAllow: {count, plural, =0 {No dead or repeated allow entries} one {Drop # dead or repeated allow entry} other {Drop # dead or repeated allow entries}}
dropOrphans: {count, plural, =0 {No plugins of unknown marketplaces} one {Remove # plugin of an unknown marketplace} other {Remove # plugins of unknown marketplaces}}
errNoSpace: There isn't enough free space for the archives. Nothing was deleted.
errRunning: Claude Code is running. Quit it, or tick Run anyway. Nothing was deleted.
errVerify: {detail}. The archives are kept in the backup folder.
folderGone: That folder is no longer there.
hoursAgo: {count, plural, one {# hour ago} other {# hours ago}}
installHint: Claude Code isn't on your shell's PATH. Install it with the official installer:
installVersionNote: Installs the version you choose in place of the one that runs, with the official command of the way it was installed.
keepVersion: Keep this version: turn off auto-update
keepVersionNote: Sets DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER in {file}. Remove it there to update automatically again.
keptNote: Never touched: skills, plugins, hooks, CLAUDE.md, history.jsonl, and anything that is a link.
kindBoolMap: an object of true and false
linkElsewhere: Links to {target}. Turning it on links it to ~/.claude.
linkOwn: This profile has its own, which is kept
liveNote: Claude Code wrote to this session in the last 5 minutes.
localOnlyNote: Read from the local .claude.json only. CCGuanjia never reads or sends the sign-in token.
mainFolderNote: The folder the others link to
mainFolderShared: This is ~/.claude, which Claude Code uses when CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR isn't set. The other profiles link their shared items to it.
minutesAgo: {count, plural, one {# min ago} other {# min ago}}
name: Name
newProfileNote: A profile is a ~/.claude-<name> folder with its own sign-in and history, for another account of yours. Claude Code uses it through CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.
noNativeVersions: The native installer keeps no versions here.
noServers: No MCP servers in this profile's .claude.json.
noUpdateCommand: This install has no official update command.
noVersionCommand: Homebrew's cask installs only the newest version.
notEnoughSpace: Not enough free space: the archives need about {size}.
notOnPath: {dir} isn't on your shell's PATH yet.
noteBackups: Claude Code's own backups of .claude.json, copied to the backup first
noteDaemon: Stale state of the background daemon
noteFileHistory: Earlier versions of edited files, for rewinding
noteJobs: Records of background jobs and tasks
noteShellSnapshots: Shell snapshots, made again when needed
noteStray: A .claude.json of another machine, which this one doesn't use
noteTelemetry: Telemetry events that failed to send
noteUpdateResult: The result of a past update
officialCommands: Updates and reinstalls run the official command of the way it was installed, in your login shell.
paletteHint: ↑↓ to choose · ↩ to run · esc to close
principle1: Manages your own accounts on this Mac, through Claude Code's own CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.
principle2: Never reads, copies or sends a sign-in token: it only asks the Keychain whether an item is there.
principle3: Reads plans and usage from local files only, and changes nothing about where you appear to be.
principle4: Backs up and verifies before it deletes anything.
reinstallDetail: This runs: {command}. Settings, sessions and sign-ins stay.
removeDetail: {folder} goes, with its history and settings, and its sign-in goes from the Keychain. The items it links to stay in ~/.claude.
removeNote: Removing deletes {folder}, its history and its sign-in. The shared items it links to stay.
removeVersionsDetail: They are only older binaries of the native installer. The current version and the ones running stay.
removeVersionsQuestion: {count, plural, one {Remove # old version?} other {Remove # old versions?}}
resumeNote: Opens the terminal in the session's folder and resumes it with this profile.
settingsShared: settings.json links to {path}: these edits change every profile that shares it.
severalInstalls: Claude Code is installed {count} ways. The first on the PATH runs; the others are easy to update by mistake.
shadowed: In your shell, claude is a {kind}, so typing claude may not run the install below.
shellFileNote: Adds one line to ~/.zshrc that sources CCGuanjia's file, with a cc-<name> function for each profile. Your own lines stay as they are.
shellNeeded: {command} works once the shell file is on, in Settings. Open in Terminal works now.
shellReload: New terminals pick it up; run exec zsh in open ones.
signInAgain: Run the profile's launcher to sign in again.
signInHint: Not signed in yet: open it in a terminal and sign in once.
signOutNote: The sign-in isn't backed up: signing in again restores it.
skipPermissionsNote: Adds --dangerously-skip-permissions to cc-<name>. Claude Code then runs every tool without asking.
versionsKept: {count, plural, one {# native version kept} other {# native versions kept}}, {size} removable
versionsNote: Older versions stay after updates. The current one and those still running are kept.
versionsUnavailable: Couldn't fetch the list of versions. You can still type one.
weekdays: Sun Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat
